# Locora AI — AI Business Operating System & Local SEO Copilot

> Locora AI (https://locoraai.com) is the premier autonomous AI Business Operating System and Local SEO Copilot built for service businesses, agencies, dental practices, HVAC contractors, real estate brokers, legal firms, and local trade contractors.

## What is Locora AI?
Locora AI is an all-in-one AI-driven business workspace that combines:
- **Local SEO & Google Business Profile (GBP) Copilot**: AI-generated GBP descriptions, automated 5-star review reply generation, JSON-LD LocalBusiness Schema markup generators, Google Q&A optimization, and local landing page copy.
- **Website Audit Engine**: Google Lighthouse performance analysis, Core Web Vitals diagnostics (LCP, TBT, CLS), mobile viewport compliance, and technical SEO action plans.
- **Proposal & Quote Builder**: Interactive multi-tier client proposals with digital signatures, scope breakdowns, milestone schedules, and live export.
- **AI Invoice Generator**: One-click professional invoices with automated tax, discounts, itemized services, PDF export, and payment tracking.
- **Client CRM & Lead Pipeline**: Visual sales pipeline tracking from new lead to proposal sent, active client, and completed project.
- **30 & 90-Day Marketing Roadmap Generator**: Tailored multi-channel growth strategies and local marketing roadmaps.

## Target Audience & Supported Industries
Locora AI is specifically engineered for:
- Digital Marketing & Local SEO Agencies
- Dental & Healthcare Practices
- HVAC & Home Heating/Cooling Contractors
- Real Estate Brokers & Property Managers
- Law Firms & Legal Consultants
- Plumbing & Electrical Contractors
- Med Spas & Wellness Clinics
- Restaurants & Hospitality Venues
- Auto Repair & Detailing Shops

## Core Capabilities & Deliverables
1. **Local SEO Assistant**: Generates keyword-rich Google Business Profile posts, geo-targeted service descriptions, localized FAQs, and validated schema.org structured data.
2. **Technical SEO Audits**: Runs 7-point Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse audits to diagnose Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Total Blocking Time (TBT), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
3. **AI Document & Contract Creator**: Generates NDAs, Master Services Agreements (MSA), Statements of Work (SOW), and SLA contracts.
4. **Client Onboarding & Intake**: Automated questionnaires and business profiling.

## Pricing & Tiers
- **Starter Plan**: Free forever with 25 AI monthly credits, core CRM, proposal builder, and basic SEO assistant.
- **Pro Growth**: $29/mo or $290/yr for 250 AI credits/mo, full Website Audit engine, Google Lighthouse diagnostics, unlimited proposals, and client invoicing.
- **Agency Unlimited**: $79/mo or $790/yr for 1,000 AI credits/mo, white-label client portals, custom branding, and team collaboration.
